verdict.rationale: Typesense's curation/ranking system lets you define rules (e.g., pinning, hiding, promoting, boosting/burying results) that automatically trigger when certain query conditions are met, which is a narrow form of rule-based automation tied to search-time events. However, there is no evidence of a general event-driven automation engine (e.g., triggers on data changes, webhooks, scheduled actions) beyond search-query curation. Missing for 10: broader event types (data ingestion, index changes, external triggers), documented action types beyond result ranking/merchandising, and any workflow/automation API outside search curation.
